title: Sound function in hard techno
description: Preliminary research, in plain language: which measurable things tell you whether a sound is a kick, a rumble, a hat, a clap, a hook or a riser — and a programme for finding out ten times more.

title: An expanded corpus and the first listening test
description: Part two of the sound-function research: a labelled library of 718 sounds, a browser role meter, a listening test, the pump measured, and hundreds of hard techno tracks with bar one found.

title: Source-separated stems and pump measurements
description: Part three: 218 hard techno tracks split into stems with a free separator; the pump measured three ways, where real kicks land, and real hits against the synthetic ones.

title: A doubled corpus and a register of tested hypotheses
description: Part four: the literature doubled, the corpus grown, a register of tested hypotheses with two reversals, loudness measured for the first time, and two more notes on where this goes.
